_how_to_edit: Edit this file to update the site. Each list renders in the order written. Status for research: Published, Preprint or Under review. Keep index.html's static copy in step so search engines see the same content.

runlog.text: Invited keynote at TAIMMA 2027 and joined its Technical Program Committee
Released the PipeMend benchmark and the pipeverify GitHub Action
Released the LEGATO preprint and the ETL-TransBench benchmark
Joined Salesforce as Lead Member of Technical Staff

research.title: Domain-Driven Data and AI Platforms: Governing Analytics and Machine Learning Pipelines at Scale
research.summary: A domain-driven reference architecture for governing analytics and ML pipelines in large enterprises.

research.title: LEGATO: Agentic Large Language Model Translation of Legacy ETL Workflows to Modern Dataflow Code with Test-Based Semantic Verification
research.summary: An agent that translates legacy ETL into Spark and checks every translation against executable data tests.

research.title: Fix or Page? Silent Harm and Safe Escalation When LLM Agents Remediate Data Pipeline Incidents
research.summary: 64 broken pipelines, three model sizes: data quality monitors approved every harmful fix, while the agents' own confidence was the useful safety signal.

research.title: When the Rules Collide: Explainability, Fairness, and Model Risk Governance in Credit Machine Learning
research.summary: A review of how fair lending law, model risk guidance and capital rules constrain one another in credit ML.

research.title: An Event-Driven Medallion Architecture with Domain-Driven Design for Training-Serving Consistent Credit Risk Feature Engineering
research.summary: Event-driven medallion pipelines that keep credit risk features consistent between training and serving.

research.title: Agent-Oriented Reference Architecture for Domain-Driven Enterprise Data Platforms
research.summary: A reference architecture for running AI agents over domain-owned enterprise data.

research.title: Domain-Driven Governance for Regulated Lakehouses: A Contract-Based Architecture and Reproducible Evaluation on Snowflake
research.summary: Governance that propagates across domains, measured with a reproducible Snowflake benchmark.

research.title: Proactive Credit Line Increase Using Risk-Constrained Explainable Machine Learning
research.summary: Credit line decisions as constrained profit maximization, with calibrated models, SHAP explanations and fairness limits.

research.title: FraudRAG: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Real-Time Financial Statement Fraud Detection Using a Domain-Driven Medallion Architecture
research.summary: A Graph-RAG pipeline combining a Neo4j knowledge graph and vector retrieval to check financial statements.

research.title: A Domain-Driven Reference Architecture for Scalable and Governed Data Systems in Regulated Enterprises
research.summary: The reference architecture behind domain-owned, governed data platforms in banking.

research.title: Risk-Aware FinOps Optimization Using Machine Learning in Regulated Multi-Cloud Environments
research.authors: G. Sharma, A. Sharma, S. A. Syed
research.summary: Calibrated cost forecasts and tail-risk optimization for cloud spend under data residency rules.

research.title: Risk-Aware Self-Healing Cloud Infrastructure Using Agentic AI and Policy-Based Remediation for Regulated Financial Systems
research.authors: G. Sharma, A. Sharma, D. Singh
research.summary: Agents propose repairs; a deterministic policy gate decides what may run.
